entities.title: Work on the Python library
entities.summary: Run the tests, the worked examples among them, from implementations/python; there is nothing to install.
steps: Use Python 3.10 or later (pyproject.toml: requires-python = ">=3.10"). The project has no dependencies, so nothing needs installing.
From the repository root, run the repository checks: python3 tools/validate.py and python3 tools/side_by_side.py --check
entities.verify: unittest reports OK, and both repository checks pass.
entities.details: The native-first zone examples and the zone tests of test_native.py read this machine's tz database, which must know the 2026–2027 rules of New York and Paris; test_native.py skips its ZoneInfo tests when America/New_York is missing, the example suites do not. The README says the library and the examples type-check with mypy --strict, but the repository gives no command or configuration for it.
